surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: rustdesk-server (hbbs / hbbr)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: 100% protocol-compatible rendezvous (hbbs) and relay (hbbr) server matching libs/hbb_common. Configured via Docker Compose / systemd self-host deployment configs without modifying protocol encryption.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.category: Primary Virtual Display Driver (Windows Headless — WHQL Signed)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: usbmmidd_v2 (Amyuni USB Mobile Monitor Virtual Display Driver)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.pkcs7_signer: CN=Microsoft Windows Hardware Compatibility Publisher -> Microsoft Windows Third Party Component CA 2014 -> Microsoft Root Certificate Authority 2010 (sha256WithRSAEncryption)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Actual driver used by upstream RustDesk v1.5.3 (src/virtual_display_manager.rs:9 IDD_IMPL_AMYUNI). Carries genuine Microsoft WHQL signature preserving UEFI Secure Boot and Driver Signature Enforcement with zero LocalMachine\Root certificate store modification. Not installed until Boss explicitly approves.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: RustDeskIddDriver
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Cryptographic audit under Section 7 proved RustDeskIddDriver v0.4 is signed with an anonymous WDK test certificate using deprecated SHA-1 and its batch script injects RustDeskIddDriver.cer into LocalMachine\Root. Hard-blocked in src/dauverse/headless.rs and build scripts.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: HDMI 2.0 / DisplayPort EDID Dummy Plug
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Passive hardware EDID emulator plugged into NVIDIA RTX 3060 providing 1080p/1440p/4K headless rendering + NVENC with zero OS driver installation.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: Hunonic SK02 Wi-Fi Smart Plug
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Official Hunonic documentation provides mobile app control only and publishes zero public REST, MQTT, or OpenAPI documentation. Per Section 6, reverse-engineered/MITM community workarounds and credential extraction are prohibited; DisabledSmartPlugAdapter remains active.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: sysinfo (rustdesk-org fork of GuillaumeGomez/sysinfo)
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Already locked in Cargo.lock and re-exported via hbb_common::sysinfo, avoiding duplicate dependency introduction while providing cross-platform CPU, RAM, Disk, Network, and AI process telemetry.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: LibreHardwareMonitor
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Primary GPU telemetry (RTX 3060 temp, VRAM, power, utilization) uses NVIDIA NVML / nvidia-smi (with CREATE_NO_WINDOW and 4s TTL cache) without third-party ring0 kernel drivers.

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.category: Desktop & Mobile UI Framework & Patched Multi-Window Engine
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: Flutter 3.24.5 + rustdesk/engine windows-x64-release
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Pinned to upstream RustDesk's multi-window-safe Flutter 3.24.5 + rustdesk/engine windows-x64-release to eliminate the stock Flutter 3.50.0 ANGLE D3D11 rx::StateManager11::updateState access violation (0xc0000005).

surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.name: Be Vietnam Pro, Inter, Roboto Mono
surveyed_upstream_ecosystems.rationale: Bundled locally under flutter/assets/fonts/ with verbatim OFL.txt files and GoogleFonts.config.allowRuntimeFetching = false.
